name: Expanded Necromancy
text:
You delve into other magical traditions. Add the Grisly Growths spell to your dirge. Add the following spells to your dirge as soon as you gain the ability to cast necromancer spells of that rank:
- 7th: Execute

- 8th: Desiccate

- 9th: Massacre

You can prepare and cast these spells as occult spells.
